title: Evidence Press productivity results ledger
description: Anonymised summary results from the two-week productivity self-test (https://evidencepress.org/productivity/measure/). Every complete submission is recorded, whatever it shows. Each entry is self-reported and uncontrolled: it applies to one person or team, their tasks and tools at that time, and is not a general finding about any method.

entryFields.role: Broad role or sector, as submitted
entryFields.method: Protocol id or a short description of the AI method used
entryFields.itemsWith: Number of items done with the method
entryFields.itemsWithout: Number of items done without it
entryFields.medianMinutesWith: Median active minutes with the method
entryFields.acceptedFirstTimeWith: Share accepted first time with the method (0 to 1)
entryFields.acceptedFirstTimeWithout: Share accepted first time without it (0 to 1)
entryFields.reworkMinutesWith: Total rework minutes with the method
entryFields.notes: Any qualification given by the submitter
